content.title: NCW Calls for Inquiry into Kallakurichi Allegations
content.caption: National Commission for Women (NCW) seeks fair and impartial inquiry into allegations of obscene WhatsApp messages sent by MLA C. Arul Vignesh to District Collector J.E. Padmaja.

slides.heading: NCW Calls for Inquiry into Kallakurichi Allegations
slides.text: National Commission for Women (NCW) seeks fair and impartial inquiry into allegations of obscene WhatsApp messages sent by MLA C. Arul Vignesh to District Collector J.E. Padmaja.

slides.heading: Allegations
slides.text: C. Arul Vignesh, MLA from Kallakurichi, Tamil Nadu, allegedly sent obscene WhatsApp messages to J.E. Padmaja, District Collector, Kallakurichi.

slides.heading: NCW's Action
slides.text: NCW chairperson Vijaya Rahatkar wrote to Tamil Nadu Director-General of Police seeking a fair and impartial inquiry.
